eps.ov: Introverted Bocchi takes up the guitar in hopes of meeting friends, but her social anxiety is not so easily conquered...
Nijika proposes that the band save up money for their next gig by doing part-time work at Starry.
Bocchi decides to try to pursue a new vocalist for the band: a classmate named Kita.
While Bocchi struggles to write the lyrics to the band's first song, Nijika arranges a special band outing.
Kessoku Band has their first song and they're ready to play their next concert, but Seika isn't so easily convinced.
When Bocchi struggles with her need to sell concert tickets, a chance meeting with an eccentric character may be just what she needs.
It's a party at Bocchi's house when the girls come by to make T-shirt designs! But can she handle her first real friend visit?!
The weather threatens to put a kibosh on enthusiasm for Kessoku Band's latest performance.
The girls take Bocchi out for one last blast before school resumes. Destination: Enoshima!
When Bocchi struggles with the decision of whether or not to perform at her school's culture festival, Kikuri arrives to offer inspiration.
The culture festival's rolled around, and the Kessoku Band girls want to enjoy it with Bocchi... if they can even find her first!
Kessoku Band's performance at the culture festival is on. Can the band make it through without disaster?
